content.value_statement: Flemish childcare providers need consistent enrollment, attendance, billing, and tax documentation. This guide helps an AI assistant draft working documents for review against current requirements.
actual_capabilities: Guide drafts of enrollment dossiers containing a childcare plan, parent agreement, and household regulations.
Help structure attendance records, billable days, exceptions, and justified absences.
Guide monthly invoice drafts using supplied child records, tariff lines, and allowance details.
Help organize information for childcare tax certificate preparation.
Frame document drafts for family childcare, group childcare, and cooperating childminders in Flanders.
limitations: The folder contains only a public guide, without executable scripts, extension source, or reusable template files.
The guide targets Flanders and does not cover Brussels or Wallonia.
Outputs are working drafts, not officially approved forms or guaranteed compliant documents.
Current tariffs, tax certificate rules, and legal changes require independent verification; no live regulatory update mechanism is included.

use_cases.title: Prepare a New Enrollment Dossier
use_cases.description: Draft a childcare plan, parent agreement, and household regulations for a new enrollment using supplied operating details.

use_cases.title: Review Monthly Billing Inputs
use_cases.description: Organize anonymized attendance records and exceptions before drafting monthly invoices with verified tariffs.

use_cases.title: Prepare Annual Certificate Information
use_cases.description: Create a review checklist for childcare tax certificate data and identify missing information before formal preparation.

prompt_templates.title: List Enrollment Documents
prompt_templates.prompt: List the documents needed to enroll a child in [childcare type] in Flanders. Use placeholders for personal information and flag requirements needing verification.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Household Regulations
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft household regulations for [provider name], a Flemish [childcare type] using [IKT or free pricing]. Include [opening hours] and mark legal clauses requiring verification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare a provider-specific working document.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile Attendance and Billing
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [anonymized attendance table] using [verified tariff rules]. Separate attended days, justified absences, and exceptions. Draft invoice lines and list unresolved billing questions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare a monthly billing review.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Annual Administration Dossier
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [anonymized dossier] against [current official requirements]. Cross-check enrollment, attendance, invoices, and certificate inputs. List inconsistencies, missing evidence, and issues requiring professional review.

output_examples.input: List the enrollment documents for a Flemish group childcare provider using IKT.
output: Childcare plan: record the agreed schedule and start date.
Parent agreement: include provider details and verified pricing terms.
Household regulations: cover opening hours, attendance, complaints, and relevant policies.
Review status: confirm current Opgroeien requirements before issuing documents.

output_examples.input: Prepare invoice review notes for child A: eight attended days, one justified absence, and no supplied tariff.
output: Attendance: eight attended days and one justified absence recorded.
Pricing: the applicable verified tariff is missing.
Exception review: confirm whether the absence affects billing under the agreement.
Invoice status: the total remains pending until pricing and absence rules are confirmed.

output_examples.input: Prepare an annual childcare tax certificate checklist without using personal identifiers.
output: Confirm the current official certificate requirements and reporting period.
Gather required provider and recipient information through approved internal processes.
Reconcile relevant attendance and payment records.
Resolve missing information before preparing the official certificate.

best_practices: Provide the childcare type, pricing model, and current official requirements before requesting a draft.
Use anonymized examples and placeholders when working with child, parent, attendance, or payment information.
Have an authorized reviewer verify legal clauses, tariffs, invoice calculations, and certificate details before use.
anti_patterns: Treating generated drafts as officially approved documents or a guarantee of legal compliance.
Assuming the guide automatically retrieves current legislation or submits invoices and tax certificates.
Sharing unnecessary child identifiers or sensitive family information when placeholders are sufficient.

faq.question: What does this skill provide?
faq.answer: It provides a public drafting guide for Flemish childcare administration, including enrollment documents, attendance, billing, and tax certificate preparation.

faq.question: Does it include scripts or reusable template files?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed folder contains only SKILL.md and explicitly excludes scripts, extension source, and original package templates.

faq.question: Does it cover childcare outside Flanders?
faq.answer: No. The guide explicitly targets Flanders and excludes Brussels and Wallonia.

faq.question: Are its legal statements guaranteed to be current?
faq.answer: No. Although the guide claims current coverage, it includes no live update mechanism or supporting legal sources. Verify requirements independently.

faq.question: Does it connect to billing or government systems?
faq.answer: No integration is included in the reviewed folder. The guide supports drafting and preparation, not automatic submission or synchronization.

faq.question: Can it support IKT and independent childminders?
faq.answer: The guide discusses IKT, free pricing, family childcare, and group childcare. Supply the relevant provider details and verify the resulting documents.
